title: Qualify visible full-shell content with current theme geometry
description: Manual review of the completed navigation matrix shows a blank main area at 360 pixels and 200-percent text although the captured HTML contains Layout body. The full-layout capture omits MudThemeProvider geometry variables, and the frame oracle does not detect app-bar content occlusion.
expected_behavior: Capture the actual theme geometry in full-shell evidence, require visibly exposed primary content and detect header occlusion. Compare hydrated shell clearance at normal/enlarged text and repair shared header sizing only when a controlled case proves overlap. Preserve navigation interaction evidence and revalidation obligations.
context: Required before workspace-readiness messages and recovery actions can receive trustworthy shell qualification. The navigation interaction run passed; the static shell content-visibility assertion was incomplete. Sources: PageLayoutEvidence.cs, AppNavMenuTests.cs, qualification-frame.mjs and MainLayout/app.css. Existing Tasks do not cover the missing full-shell fixture/oracle.
